uncertainties.note: 'malice has arrived' (jaki ga kita ka) translated literally; researched and found no special in-show meaning, ability name, or character epithet using this term in Overman King Gainer sources. Speaker and referent are not identifiable from surrounding context.
Compressed source phrase ('battle with King and a real Overman') interpreted as marveling at facing King Gainer as a genuine Overman; meaning kept close to source without inventing additional detail.
Wordplay on the source's double meaning of 'sweet/naive' approximated as 'soft...too soft! Sweeter than chocolate!' to preserve the pun rather than translating literally.

Gainer's interlocutor in this post-mission talk is not named or gendered in these rows; kept neutral throughout. 'She' is used only for Cynthia Lane, whose gender is already locked in the project glossary.
'invader' kept lowercase as an ad hoc taunt about the Dominator's flying-saucer shape, not a named enemy faction; same treatment as the parallel occurrence in batch_04398 (row 4457).

Kids Munt (Siberian Railway president) identified via web search of King Gainer character/plot summaries, not yet in the project's own glossary files; recommend adding to character_names_021.json centrally rather than proposing here since no dedicated wiki page with sourced gender/personality was found in this pass.
